sql: SELECT c.name, count(li.id) AS total, count(li.id) FILTER (WHERE li.updated_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS upd7, count(li.id) FILTER (WHERE li.priority_flag) AS prioridade, count(li.id) FILTER (WHERE li.ai_summary IS NOT NULL) AS com_resumo_ia, max(li.ai_summary_at)::date AS ult_resumo_ia, count(li.id) FILTER (WHERE li.last_customer_message_at IS NOT NULL) AS com_msg_cliente, max(li.last_customer_message_at)::date AS ult_msg_cliente, count(li.id) FILTER (WHERE li.intent_tags IS NOT NULL AND li.intent_tags::text NOT IN ('[]', '{}', 'null')) AS com_tags, (SELECT string_agg(t || ':' || n, ' ') FROM (SELECT x.temperature AS t, count(*) AS n FROM lead_intelligence x WHERE x.company_id = c.id GROUP BY 1) s) AS temperaturas, (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(a, '-') || ':' || n, ' ') FROM (SELECT x.abandonment_type AS a, count(*) AS n FROM lead_intelligence x WHERE x.company_id = c.id GROUP BY 1) s) AS abandono, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = c.id) AS leads_total FROM companies c LEFT JOIN lead_intelligence li ON li.company_id = c.id WHERE c.slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao', 'megamegic', 'planeta-divertido') GROUP BY c.id, c.name
